name: procureops-analyst
description: Fulfill procurement operations analyst tasks using a shared ProcureOps API. Use this skill whenever a user asks you to prepare a sourcing nomination packet, close out a receiving batch, resolve AP invoice holds, evaluate a contract change request, release receiving/AP exceptions, or perform any other operational-analyst workflow that names ProcureOps, procurement, sourcing, receiving, AP, vendor risk, or supply-chain operations.  Even when the user does not mention ProcureOps explicitly this skill should activate if the task involves procurement reconciliations, three-way matching, PO closeout, invoice-hold decisions, budget-impact analysis, or supplier-risk checks against a structured procurement data set.
